run_single_atom_prediction: run single_atom_prediction_from_lookup to get DFT reference energy for a single isolated atom system
test_single_atom_prediction: test single_atom_prediction_from_lookup with an AtomicData batch containing one atom and no PBC
review_single_atom_prediction: review single_atom_prediction_from_lookup to understand how it handles single atom systems with precomputed DFT references
refactor_single_atom_prediction: refactor single_atom_prediction_from_lookup to support additional properties beyond energy, forces, and stress
summarize_single_atom_prediction: summarize single_atom_prediction_from_lookup which returns precomputed DFT energies for single isolated atoms instead of model predictions
